The current database connection

Source: R/data-connection.R
db_con.Rd

Returns the package connection, opening one if needed: the last database used in this session if there was one, otherwise the database db_connect() finds with no arguments (AUSPARL_DB, then the copy installed by db_download()). Every query function calls this, so you rarely need it directly.

Usage

db_con()

Value

A DBI connection.

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
DBI::dbListTables(db_con())
#>  [1] "actions"                           "committee_members"                
#>  [3] "debates"                           "dict"
